releases.notes:
[1.4-alpha-9 -> 1.4-alpha-10]
-Added setting "hit_range" to allow player in playback hit other entities and specify how far they can hit (0 by default).
-Added setting "use_authlib_services" to replace new, custom implementation of mojang API requests with authlib implementation (false by default).
-Added setting "player_name_handling" to change how casing of player names and their profiles are handled (ignore_casing by default).
-Renamed setting "assign_player_name" to "assign_profile" - it now assigns UUID and skin as well.
-Added ability to create skin lists (thanks to Laynce for suggestion).
-It's now possible to remove assigned skin from playback (including scene element) modifiers.
-Improvements to loading profiles.
-Mod version number now includes target Minecraft version.
-Improved loading skins from MineSkin - requests are now cached and URL verification is more strict.
-Added limit to custom skin file size and to cumulative custom skin file and texture sizes.
-Fixed player position issues after changing dimension (thanks to VLTNO for reporting).
-Fixed invalid scene version number after modifying scene in legacy format.
-Fixed various issues caused by Java localization.
-Added French translation (thanks to LOUDO56).

releases.notes:
===Version 1.2.1===
-Fixed a compatibility issue causing skin top layer not being visible (thanks KlashRaick, JLUsr and efi1212 for reporting).
-Fixed fake players not being removed from the server level causing memory leaks, performance issues, strange mob behaviour, problems with placing blocks, blocks staying activated and probably many other bad things (thanks KlashRaick for reporting).
-When mod is not installed on a client-side, the server now sends text with English translation instead of translation keys.
